messages:
Maya Chen: Hey @here — thinking about a mini Redwood Holiday Postcard Exchange! Send or receive a physical postcard (handwritten). Reply with "send" or "receive" + DM me for mailing addresses. I'll compile signups by next Friday. :postbox:

Jon Reyes: send! i'll include a ridiculous sticker :laughing:

Priya Patel: send — can I prioritize EU recipients? traveling home to Dublin, want to swap local postcards :pray:

Eliot Kim: receive. would love a tiny map or local snack pic :yum:

Sam O'Neill: send (office pickup ok?). also can we set a cut-off date?

Maya Chen: Cut-off = Dec 18 for shipping to hit before holidays. If you're sending from abroad add a note. Office pickup is fine — address is the usual HQ mailroom, DM me for details.

Natalie Ruiz: receive — traveling Dec 22-29 so if anyone's sending late pls mark "hold for Jan" on envelope :sweat_smile:

Jon Reyes: can we do a low-effort 'design brief' thread for folks who want templates? i can post a tiny printable with 4 postcard sizes.

Priya Patel: yes please @jon — and maybe a folder in Drive for scans of postcards? would be nice to see them digitally too.

Maya Chen: love both ideas. jon, if you share i'll pin. drive folder = https://redwood.example/holiday-postcards

Eliot Kim: also open to anonymous swaps — if you write "anon" i'll blind-match.

Sam O'Neill: quick logistics Q: anyone allergic to glue/stickers? only asking because my postcard empire includes glitter :sparkles:

Maya Chen: ha — note about glitter optional. also if anyone wants to swap small bakes along with a postcard, add +cookie in your reply.

Jon Reyes: +cookie. warning: mediocre oatmeal cookies but made with love :cookie:

Priya Patel: +cookie? maybe postage gets weird cross-border though.

Maya Chen: Good point — for cross-border, cookies = optional and at sender's risk. We'll keep postcards as default.

signup-bot: Added Maya's thread to #random-events calendar. (bot)

Maya Chen: I'll DM addresses and post the final matched list on Monday. Thanks y'all! :heart:

Eliot Kim: yay! excited :tada:

Natalie Ruiz: thank you! great way to feel connected this season :sparkling_heart:
